name: Duty or tax or fee category code
description: Code specifying a duty or tax or fee category.

values.name: Mixed tax rate
values.description: Mixed tax rate Code specifying that the rate is based on mixed tax.

values.name: Lower rate
values.description: Lower rate Tax rate is lower than standard rate.

values.name: Exempt for resale
values.description: Exempt for resale A tax category code indicating the item is tax exempt when the item is bought for future resale.

values.name: Value Added Tax (VAT) not now due for payment
values.description: Value Added Tax (VAT) not now due for payment A code to indicate that the Value Added Tax (VAT) amount which is due on the current invoice is to be paid on receipt of a separate VAT payment request.

values.name: Value Added Tax (VAT) due from a previous invoice
values.description: Value Added Tax (VAT) due from a previous invoice A code to indicate that the Value Added Tax (VAT) amount of a previous invoice is to be paid.

values.name: VAT Reverse Charge
values.description: VAT Reverse Charge Code specifying that the standard VAT rate is levied from the invoicee.

values.name: Transferred (VAT)
values.description: Transferred (VAT) VAT not to be paid to the issuer of the invoice but directly to relevant tax authority.

values.name: Duty paid by supplier
values.description: Duty paid by supplier Duty associated with shipment of goods is paid by the supplier; customer receives goods with duty paid.

values.name: Exempt from tax
values.description: Exempt from tax Code specifying that taxes are not applicable.

values.name: Free export item, tax not charged
values.description: Free export item, tax not charged Code specifying that the item is free export and taxes are not charged.

values.name: Higher rate
values.description: Higher rate Code specifying a higher rate of duty or tax or fee.

values.name: Services outside scope of tax
values.description: Services outside scope of tax Code specifying that taxes are not applicable to the services.

values.name: Standard rate
values.description: Standard rate Code specifying the standard rate.

values.name: Zero rated goods
values.description: Zero rated goods Code specifying that the goods are at a zero rate.
